attendance.marked_by.comment: Faculty ID who marked the attendance

courses.course_level.comment: Course level determines lecture duration defaults

courses.lecture_duration_minutes.comment: Default lecture duration for this course (PG: 60min, UG: 45min)

courses.max_sessions_per_day.comment: Maximum sessions per day for this course

timetable_session_targets.target_session.comment: Ideal number of sessions to schedule

unscheduled_sessions_log.reason.comment: Why it could not be scheduled

user_permissions.class_id.comment: NULL = all classes, specific ID = that class only

user_permissions.course_id.comment: NULL = all courses, specific ID = that course only

course_batches.comment: Course batch management for student groups

elective_groups.comment: Elective subject groups for student selection

faculty_allocations.comment: Faculty subject allocations with workload tracking

faculty_availability.comment: Faculty weekly availability with shift templates and custom time slots. start_time/end_time can differ from shift times.

student_subject_selections.comment: Student subject selections and academic progress

subjects.comment: Enhanced subjects with comprehensive academic details

attendance_summary.definition: select `s`.`id` AS `student_id`,`s`.`name` AS `student_name`,`s`.`roll_number` AS `roll_number`,`subj`.`id` AS `subject_id`,`subj`.`name` AS `subject_name`,`c`.`id` AS `class_id`,`c`.`name` AS `class_name`,`d`.`id` AS `division_id`,`d`.`name` AS `division_name`,count(distinct `t`.`id`) AS `total_lectures_scheduled`,count(distinct case when `a`.`status` = 'Present' then `a`.`id` end) AS `lectures_attended`,count(distinct case when `a`.`status` = 'Late' then `a`.`id` end) AS `lectures_late`,count(distinct case when `a`.`status` = 'Absent' then `a`.`id` end) AS `lectures_missed`,round(count(distinct case when `a`.`status` in ('Present','Late') then `a`.`id` end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(distinct `t`.`id`),0),2) AS `attendance_percentage` from (((((`students` `s` join `timetable` `t`) left join `attendance` `a` on(`a`.`student_id` = `s`.`id` and `a`.`timetable_id` = `t`.`id`)) left join `subjects` `subj` on(`t`.`subject_id` = `subj`.`id`)) left join `classes` `c` on(`t`.`class_id` = `c`.`id`)) left join `divisions` `d` on(`t`.`division_id` = `d`.`id`)) where `t`.`course_id` = `s`.`course_id` and `t`.`class_id` = `s`.`class_id` and `t`.`division_id` = `s`.`division_id` group by `s`.`id`,`subj`.`id`,`c`.`id`,`d`.`id`

student_overall_attendance.definition: select `s`.`id` AS `student_id`,`s`.`name` AS `student_name`,`s`.`roll_number` AS `roll_number`,`s`.`email` AS `email`,`c`.`name` AS `class_name`,`d`.`name` AS `division_name`,count(distinct case when `a`.`attendance_date` <= curdate() then `t`.`id` end) AS `total_lectures`,count(distinct case when `a`.`status` = 'Present' then `a`.`id` end) AS `total_present`,count(distinct case when `a`.`status` = 'Late' then `a`.`id` end) AS `total_late`,count(distinct case when `a`.`status` = 'Absent' then `a`.`id` end) AS `total_absent`,round(count(distinct case when `a`.`status` in ('Present','Late') then `a`.`id` end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(distinct case when `a`.`attendance_date` <= curdate() then `t`.`id` end),0),2) AS `overall_percentage` from ((((`students` `s` join `classes` `c` on(`s`.`class_id` = `c`.`id`)) join `divisions` `d` on(`s`.`division_id` = `d`.`id`)) left join `timetable` `t` on(`t`.`course_id` = `s`.`course_id` and `t`.`class_id` = `s`.`class_id` and `t`.`division_id` = `s`.`division_id`)) left join `attendance` `a` on(`a`.`student_id` = `s`.`id` and `a`.`timetable_id` = `t`.`id`)) group by `s`.`id`,`c`.`id`,`d`.`id`

v_consecutive_slot_opportunities.definition: select `c`.`code` AS `course_code`,`c`.`name` AS `course_name`,`cl`.`name` AS `class_name`,`d`.`name` AS `division_name`,`days`.`day_name` AS `day_name`,cast('09:00:00' as time(6)) AS `slot_start`,cast('17:00:00' as time(6)) AS `slot_end`,timestampdiff(HOUR,cast('09:00:00' as time(6)),cast('17:00:00' as time(6))) AS `available_hours`,coalesce(`scheduled`.`occupied_hours`,0) AS `occupied_hours`,timestampdiff(HOUR,cast('09:00:00' as time(6)),cast('17:00:00' as time(6))) - coalesce(`scheduled`.`occupied_hours`,0) AS `free_hours`,floor((timestampdiff(HOUR,cast('09:00:00' as time(6)),cast('17:00:00' as time(6))) - coalesce(`scheduled`.`occupied_hours`,0)) / (`c`.`lecture_duration_minutes` / 60.0)) AS `max_consecutive_sessions` from ((((`courses` `c` join `classes` `cl`) join `divisions` `d`) join (select 'Monday' AS `day_name` union select 'Tuesday' AS `Tuesday` union select 'Wednesday' AS `Wednesday` union select 'Thursday' AS `Thursday` union select 'Friday' AS `Friday` union select 'Saturday' AS `Saturday`) `days`) left join (select `timetable`.`course_id` AS `course_id`,`timetable`.`class_id` AS `class_id`,`timetable`.`division_id` AS `division_id`,`timetable`.`day_of_week` AS `day_of_week`,sum(timestampdiff(HOUR,`timetable`.`start_time`,`timetable`.`end_time`)) AS `occupied_hours` from `timetable` group by `timetable`.`course_id`,`timetable`.`class_id`,`timetable`.`division_id`,`timetable`.`day_of_week`) `scheduled` on(`scheduled`.`course_id` = `c`.`id` and `scheduled`.`class_id` = `cl`.`id` and `scheduled`.`division_id` = `d`.`id` and `scheduled`.`day_of_week` = `days`.`day_name`)) where `c`.`id` = 3 and `cl`.`id` = 1 and `d`.`id` = 1

v_curriculum_overview.definition: select `c`.`id` AS `course_id`,`c`.`name` AS `course_name`,`c`.`program` AS `program`,`c`.`duration_years` AS `duration_years`,`c`.`total_semesters` AS `total_semesters`,`sem`.`semester_number` AS `semester_number`,`sem`.`semester_name` AS `semester_name`,count(`s`.`id`) AS `total_subjects`,sum(`s`.`credits`) AS `total_credits`,sum(case when `s`.`course_type` = 'Core' then `s`.`credits` else 0 end) AS `core_credits`,sum(case when `s`.`course_type` like '%Elective%' then `s`.`credits` else 0 end) AS `elective_credits`,sum(case when `s`.`theory_practical` = 'Practical' then `s`.`credits` else 0 end) AS `practical_credits` from ((`courses` `c` join `semesters` `sem`) left join `subjects` `s` on(`c`.`id` = `s`.`course_id` and `sem`.`id` = `s`.`semester_id`)) where `c`.`is_active` = 1 group by `c`.`id`,`c`.`name`,`c`.`program`,`c`.`duration_years`,`c`.`total_semesters`,`sem`.`semester_number`,`sem`.`semester_name` order by `c`.`program`,`c`.`name`,`sem`.`semester_number`

v_faculty_daily_workload.definition: select `t`.`faculty_id` AS `faculty_id`,`f`.`name` AS `faculty_name`,`t`.`day_of_week` AS `day_of_week`,count(0) AS `total_sessions`,sum(time_to_sec(timediff(`t`.`end_time`,`t`.`start_time`)) / 3600) AS `total_hours`,group_concat(distinct `c`.`code` order by `c`.`code` ASC separator ',') AS `courses_taught` from ((`timetable` `t` join `faculty` `f` on(`f`.`user_id` = `t`.`faculty_id`)) join `courses` `c` on(`c`.`id` = `t`.`course_id`)) group by `t`.`faculty_id`,`f`.`name`,`t`.`day_of_week`

v_faculty_schedule_conflicts.definition: select `t1`.`faculty_id` AS `faculty_id`,`f`.`name` AS `faculty_name`,`t1`.`day_of_week` AS `day_of_week`,`t1`.`start_time` AS `start_time`,`t1`.`end_time` AS `end_time`,`t1`.`course_id` AS `course1_id`,`c1`.`code` AS `course1_code`,`c1`.`name` AS `course1_name`,`t1`.`class_id` AS `class1_id`,`t2`.`course_id` AS `course2_id`,`c2`.`code` AS `course2_code`,`c2`.`name` AS `course2_name`,`t2`.`class_id` AS `class2_id`,'Time Overlap' AS `conflict_reason` from ((((`timetable` `t1` join `timetable` `t2` on(`t1`.`faculty_id` = `t2`.`faculty_id` and `t1`.`day_of_week` = `t2`.`day_of_week` and `t1`.`id` < `t2`.`id` and `t1`.`start_time` < `t2`.`end_time` and `t1`.`end_time` > `t2`.`start_time`)) join `faculty` `f` on(`f`.`user_id` = `t1`.`faculty_id`)) join `courses` `c1` on(`c1`.`id` = `t1`.`course_id`)) join `courses` `c2` on(`c2`.`id` = `t2`.`course_id`))

v_faculty_workload.definition: select `f`.`id` AS `faculty_id`,`f`.`name` AS `faculty_name`,`f`.`email` AS `email`,`d`.`name` AS `department_name`,count(`fa`.`id`) AS `total_subjects`,sum(`s`.`credits`) AS `total_credits`,sum(`fa`.`allocated_hours`) AS `total_hours`,avg(`fa`.`workload_percentage`) AS `avg_workload_percentage`,`f`.`max_hours_per_week` AS `max_hours_per_week` from (((`faculty` `f` left join `departments` `d` on(`f`.`department_id` = `d`.`id`)) left join `faculty_allocations` `fa` on(`f`.`id` = `fa`.`faculty_id`)) left join `subjects` `s` on(`fa`.`subject_id` = `s`.`id`)) group by `f`.`id`,`f`.`name`,`f`.`email`,`d`.`name`,`f`.`max_hours_per_week`

v_scheduling_flexibility.definition: select `c`.`code` AS `course_code`,`c`.`name` AS `course_name`,count(distinct `s`.`id`) AS `total_subjects`,sum(`s`.`lectures_per_week`) AS `total_theory_lectures`,sum(ceiling(`s`.`practical_hours_per_week` / 2)) AS `total_practical_sessions`,sum(`s`.`lectures_per_week` + ceiling(`s`.`practical_hours_per_week` / 2)) AS `total_required_sessions`,coalesce((select `timetable_generation_settings`.`setting_value` from `timetable_generation_settings` where `timetable_generation_settings`.`course_id` = `c`.`id` and `timetable_generation_settings`.`setting_key` = 'min_sessions_per_week'),'20') AS `min_acceptable_sessions`,coalesce((select `timetable_generation_settings`.`setting_value` from `timetable_generation_settings` where `timetable_generation_settings`.`course_id` = `c`.`id` and `timetable_generation_settings`.`setting_key` = 'target_sessions_per_week'),'24') AS `target_sessions`,(select count(0) from (`faculty_allocations` `fa` join `subjects` `s2` on(`s2`.`id` = `fa`.`subject_id`)) where `s2`.`course_id` = `c`.`id`) AS `total_faculty_allocations` from (`courses` `c` left join `subjects` `s` on(`s`.`course_id` = `c`.`id`)) group by `c`.`id`,`c`.`code`,`c`.`name`

v_subjects_detailed.definition: select `s`.`id` AS `id`,`s`.`name` AS `name`,`s`.`course_code` AS `course_code`,`s`.`course_type` AS `course_type`,`s`.`theory_practical` AS `theory_practical`,`s`.`credits` AS `credits`,`s`.`theory_credits` AS `theory_credits`,`s`.`practical_credits` AS `practical_credits`,`s`.`lectures_per_week` AS `lectures_per_week`,`s`.`is_elective` AS `is_elective`,`c`.`name` AS `course_name`,`c`.`program` AS `program`,`d`.`name` AS `department_name`,`sem`.`semester_name` AS `semester_name`,`sem`.`semester_number` AS `semester_number`,`s`.`description` AS `description` from (((`subjects` `s` left join `courses` `c` on(`s`.`course_id` = `c`.`id`)) left join `departments` `d` on(`c`.`department_id` = `d`.`id`)) left join `semesters` `sem` on(`s`.`semester_id` = `sem`.`id`))

v_user_all_permissions.definition: select distinct `u`.`id` AS `user_id`,`u`.`username` AS `username`,`u`.`role` AS `role`,`p`.`id` AS `permission_id`,`p`.`name` AS `permission_name`,`p`.`module` AS `permission_module`,case when `rp`.`role_id` is not null then 'role' when `up`.`id` is not null then 'individual' when `upg`.`id` is not null then 'group' end AS `source`,coalesce(`up`.`department_id`,`upg`.`department_id`) AS `department_id`,coalesce(`up`.`course_id`,`upg`.`course_id`) AS `course_id`,coalesce(`up`.`class_id`,`upg`.`class_id`) AS `class_id`,`up`.`expires_at` AS `expires_at` from ((((((`users` `u` join `permissions` `p`) left join `roles` `r` on(`u`.`role` = `r`.`name`)) left join `role_permissions` `rp` on(`r`.`id` = `rp`.`role_id` and `p`.`id` = `rp`.`permission_id`)) left join `user_permissions` `up` on(`u`.`id` = `up`.`user_id` and `p`.`id` = `up`.`permission_id` and `up`.`is_active` = 1 and (`up`.`expires_at` is null or `up`.`expires_at` > current_timestamp()))) left join `user_permission_groups` `upg` on(`u`.`id` = `upg`.`user_id` and `upg`.`is_active` = 1)) left join `permission_group_permissions` `pgp` on(`upg`.`group_id` = `pgp`.`group_id` and `p`.`id` = `pgp`.`permission_id`)) where `rp`.`role_id` is not null or `up`.`id` is not null or `upg`.`id` is not null
